build_gtn_package: build the gtn python package with cmake extensions using pip install from source
build_gtn_extension: build a single gtn cmake extension module like gtn._graph or gtn._autograd
configure_cmake_build: configure the cmake build with debug or release mode for gtn python bindings
install_gtn_from_source: install the gtn library from source with python bindings enabled and tests disabled
validate_cmake_version: validate that cmake version 3.5.1 or higher is installed before building gtn
